Name: Eber, Son of Elpaal
Summary: Son of Elpaal, named among the sons of Elpaal.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:12: Son of Elpaal, named among the sons of Elpaal.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Eber stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
